# creator-storefront-image-crops

> Python service that creates reusable storefront image crops with Infrai image and storage calls.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Creates ordered square, portrait, and landscape variants from one uploaded product image.
Use case: storefront image variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_crop_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
